name: vancouver
summary: Vancouver combines snow-capped mountains, sea and forest at the city's doorstep with a rapidly expanding technological ecosystem and an exceptional quality of life. However, it is one of the most expensive cities in North America to live in – especially in housing – and its long and very rainy winters are not for everyone.
